source.note: A mālā-mantra (a prose "garland" mantra), not a metrical hymn; line breaks as in the source. Only one witness was found. Its last words, महारूद्राजापियत स्वाहा, are garbled; they are printed here as महारुद्र आज्ञापयति स्वाहा ("the Great Rudra commands: svāhā"), a conjecture based on the stock closing formula "… आज्ञापयति स्वाहा" of such mantras. Treat that phrase as uncertain. IAST generated by scripts/deva_to_iast.py; English translation prepared for this app.

lines.devanagari: अम्भोद्भवसमस्तदोषान् हन हन सर सर चल चल कम्प कम्प

lines.iast: matha matha huṃ phaṭ huṃ phaṭ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ mahārudra ājñāpayati svāhā ।
